findings: Primary button closes with true, No with false, Cancel with null only for YesNoCancel and false otherwise. Window-manager close leaves initially null result; keyboard/default-button selection remains in unread XAML.
DefaultButton property defaults to OK even for YesNo button sets unless caller overrides. Whether OK maps to primary Yes focus requires XAML inspection; no keyboard behavior claim.

Primary label getter caches OK or Yes based on current Buttons value. Changing Buttons after first access does not invalidate that cached label; normal object-initializer ordering may avoid this scenario.
MessageBoxWindow copies secondary text only when explicit copy command runs. No clipboard operation executed. DataContext event detachment has the same nonmodel/null context gap seen in MainView.
Custom button actions are synchronous Action delegates; some reviewed callers supply async lambdas, creating async-void callback error/lifetime behavior. Full exception propagation remains untested.
